messages.text: The probes show frequency tie order is intentionally process-randomized by Rust’s hash map, so no independent implementation can predict a tied oracle run; exact differential cases must avoid ties while still validating ascending/descending count order. The stats mismatch is deterministic and comes from streaming median collection stopping after type degradation, while slice must flush its header before validating the range. I’m applying those semantics and forcing every diagnostic/plain-text output through binary streams to eliminate Windows CRLF translation.
